requirement.title: In-dashboard visual notifications
requirement.description: Status changes and events appear as visual indicators in the dashboard: highlighted rows in the session table and entries in the notification feed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a session transitions from "active" to "needs_attention", when the dashboard re-renders, then the session row shows the ⚡ status dot and the row is highlighted.
Given a new notification event occurs, when the notification feed updates, then the event appears at the top with a relative timestamp.

requirement.title: macOS native notifications
requirement.description: On status transitions to "idle" or "needs_attention", and on session start/end events, a macOS system notification is pushed via osascript or terminal-notifier.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a session transitions to "needs_attention", when Notifier fires, then a macOS notification appears with title "gmux" and body identifying the session and reason.
Given a session transitions to "idle" (from "active"), when Notifier fires, then a macOS notification appears indicating the session finished.
Given osascript/terminal-notifier is unavailable or fails, when Notifier attempts to push, then the failure is logged and only the in-dashboard notification is shown. gmux does not crash.

requirement.title: Notification cooldown
requirement.description: To prevent notification spam, macOS native notifications for the same session are rate-limited with a 5-minute cooldown. In-dashboard visual notifications are not rate-limited.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a macOS notification was sent for session arcforge 2 minutes ago, when another notification event fires for the same session, then the macOS notification is suppressed. The in-dashboard notification still appears.
Given a macOS notification was sent for session arcforge 6 minutes ago, when another notification event fires for the same session, then the macOS notification is sent (cooldown expired).
Given a macOS notification was sent for session arcforge, when a notification fires for a different session (workspace), then the macOS notification is sent (cooldown is per-session).

requirement.title: Optional notification sound
requirement.description: Notifications can optionally play a sound. Configured in ~/.config/gmux/config.json under the "sound" key (boolean, default: false).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given sound is enabled in config, when a macOS notification fires, then the system default notification sound plays.
Given sound is disabled or config is absent, when a macOS notification fires, then no sound plays.
